paras: Dixcel 2-piece front brake discs are a high-performance upgrade for Subaru models equipped with factory 4-pot Brembo calipers. Designed for improved cooling, reduced unsprung weight, and greater resistance to heat fade, these rotors are ideal for spirited street driving and track use.

The lightweight aluminium bell and high-carbon rotor ring provide stable braking performance under repeated high-temperature cycles. Directional vane construction ensures efficient cooling, and the slotted surface maintains consistent bite by removing gas and debris from the pad surface.
hl: High-carbon cast iron rotor rings for superior heat stability
Lightweight aluminium bell to reduce unsprung mass
Heat-treated for long-term durability under repeated high-load braking
Slotted surface for consistent pad bite and improved modulation
Directional vanes for efficient cooling and reduced fade
Anti-corrosion coating for protection against rust
ft: DIXCEL 2-Piece Front Brake Discs for Subaru WRX STI (GDB/GR/GV/VAB) / BRZ / Toyota GR86 (4-Pot Brembo) – 326x30mm
